subject: Office furniture for new Pune office - 40 workstations
body:
Hello,

We are Zenith Works, a design consultancy setting up a new office in Baner, Pune. We need to fit out 40 workstations before the end of August - that means 40 desks (height-adjustable preferred) and 40 ergonomic chairs with good lumbar support.

Our budget for this is around Rs. 18 lakh. Could you share a quotation and bulk pricing? Happy to visit your showroom this week if needed.

Regards,
Priya Mehta
Procurement Lead, Zenith Works
+91 98220 44xxx
